# HexPiece 3.6.5

Your two newest notes. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, and both were rendered in previews and
checked.

## The Mochi fruit is alive: stretchy, squishy, elastic
Your words: "feels like mochi is dead, it should be more stretchy, more animated, more squishy, it's mochi for god's sake, the arms
should have more elasticity".
- **Every mochi arm** (your punches, the donuts' fists, Lotus' fists, the Anemone's arms) now behaves like stretched dough: it gets
  thinner in the middle the further it stretches, a wobble keeps rippling along it side to side and up and down, and it sags a little
  under its own weight. With Haki on it is harder, so it wobbles less.
- **Your punch** shoots out past its reach and springs back onto it, wobbling, and the fist squashes out as it lands.
- **Every donut breathes**: its ring and its dough swell and ease all the time, and the dough swells as a fist pushes out of it.
- **The dough's lumps churn twice as fast**, so every mass of mochi keeps moving.
- **Buzz Cut Mochi's** long white arm ripples and thins as it stretches out too.

## WiFi Haki uses the new Haki lightning
Your words: "I also found traces of the old Haki in the wifi haki, it should use our latest one."
WiFi Haki's strike was still drawn with the original mod's flat beams. It is now the one 3D Haki lightning (the same round, lit bolts
as the Conqueror's release, sharp tips, in your Haki colour), racing from your blade to the one it strikes with a few forks off it.

The Awakening's other moves (Z to N while awakened) are still being built; for now their keys say so.
